answer: Each operator may hold only one live work slot. To keep it, the key publishes a rolling cedar log of five attested solutions, each bound to a beacon revealed after a ninety-second commit, so one typist cannot ghostwrite a herd in parallel. The slot deposit sits in a shared insurance haven and is slashed if two slots sign the same beacon with matching latency or identical tool fingerprints. Keys that later cash out to the same long-term tundra wallet are fused into one seat, and the surplus deposit pays the reporter. Extra identities miss beacons and lose bonds, rather than buying extra votes.
